page.overview:
What is Dream No More?

Dream No More is the fifth song from Metallica's tenth studio album Hardwired...to Self-Destruct.

It draws inspiration from the cosmic horror found in H.P. Lovecraft's Cthulhu Mythos. It tells the story of the ancient being, Cthulhu, waking up and spreading fear and destruction across the world. The lyrics talk about how you can't escape its power, saying things like, "Turn to stone, can't look away," and it all leads to the terrifying return of complete chaos.

He sleeps under black seas waiting Lies dreaming in death He sleeps under cosmos shaking Stars granting his breath

He wakes as the world dies screaming All horrors arrive He wakes giving earth its bleeding Pure madness alive
